notes: Ruled 2026-11-17 (kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-17-rulings-pb5789-folios.md) against the printed folios transcribed from the GovInfo scan (kb/Work PB5789). PARTIAL. Rolling forward (b), subtotalling with and without UPON (c) and crossfooting itself (a, first paragraph) run at 85 (1985-GR-XIII_3_19_4-9, g85_bf09_09). Two printed paragraphs of a fail: kb/Work PB5894 (wrong answer: crossfooting runs in dependency order, not 'according to the sequence in which sum counters are defined within the control footing report group'; rford.cob prints CF +006 +003 +003 where definition order gives +003 +003 +003) and kb/Work PB5895 (rejects legal source: a sum counter that is its own addend, S5 SUM WS-A S5, is refused COBOL2730 under the 2023 rule §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4e, though GR9a provides for it and §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1 permits the addend). Supersedes the CONFORMS notes decided on item a alone against the reconstruction.

next.reason: 1985 GR9: crossfooting (a), rolling forward (b) and subtotalling (c), each at its time; crossfooting in the order the counters are defined, and a counter that is its own addend contributes its value at the time of summation (printed folio XIII-54, kb/Work PB5789). §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 and SR5 restrict the addends (SR4e forbids a non-terminating chain, a self addend included), §2023:13.18.54.4 GR6 orders the additions by dependency, GR7 gives the times.
